Subiect: Security notice for services using Ghostscript or ImageMagick

Conținut:
Hello,

On November 21, researchers published details of a
vulnerability in Ghostscript known as Upload2Shell
(CVE-2026-125396). This vulnerability can allow remote code
execution when Ghostscript processes a maliciously crafted
file.

What to do if you use Ghostscript

If you have a Render service that uses Ghostscript, make
sure you're running a patched version as soon as possible.
This includes services that use Ghostscript through another
tool such as ImageMagick or Pillow.

- For services on a Render native runtime, a patched
  version of Ghostscript is now bundled with the runtime.
  If your service hasn't deployed successfully since
  November 20, 2026, at 20:00 UTC, trigger a deploy from
  your service's page in the Render Dashboard.
  https://dashboard.render.com

- For services that use Docker or bundle their own copy of
  Ghostscript, update Ghostscript before redeploying.

For additional details, please see our Upload2Shell
advisory.

https://render.com/docs/advisory-upload2shell

If you have questions or need assistance, reach out to our
support team in the Render Dashboard.

https://dashboard.render.com?contact-support

Thank you,
The Render Team

You are receiving this security advisory even if you have
opted out of marketing communications.

memorii.detalii:
De la: The CodeRabbit Team <hello@coderabbit.ai>
ID Gmail: 1a213a0e3c86c02e
Thread: 1a213a0e3c86c02e
Data: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:54:00 +0000
Subiect: Stop bad code before it merges

Conținut:
CodeRabbit

 

Hi bogdanstancu1119-maker,

Two features that work together. Set them up once and CodeRabbit enforces your team's conventions on every PR.

1. Path instructions → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/configuration/path-instructions )

Teach CodeRabbit your codebase rules per directory.

reviews:
  path_instructions:
    - path: "src/api/**"
      instructions: |
        - All endpoints must validate input via zod schemas
        - Auth middleware required before route handlers

2. Pre-merge checks → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/pr-reviews/pre-merge-checks )

Block PRs that violate your standards.

reviews:
  pre_merge_checks:
    docstrings:
      mode: "warning"
      threshold: 80
    description:
      mode: "warning"

Start both in warning mode. Move to error once your team is aligned. When paired with the Request Changes Workflow ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/reference/configuration#param-request-changes-workflow ), error mode blocks merges until issues are resolved or manually overridden.

Learn more about path instructions → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/configuration/path-instructions )

Learn more about pre-merge checks → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/pr-reviews/pre-merge-checks )

memorii.titlu: [GMAIL] Stop bad code before it merges
memorii.detalii:
De la: The CodeRabbit Team <hello@coderabbit.ai>
ID Gmail: 1a213a0e3c86c02e
Thread: 1a213a0e3c86c02e
Data: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:54:00 +0000
Subiect: Stop bad code before it merges

Conținut:
CodeRabbit

 

Hi bogdanstancu1119-maker,

Two features that work together. Set them up once and CodeRabbit enforces your team's conventions on every PR.

1. Path instructions → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/configuration/path-instructions )

Teach CodeRabbit your codebase rules per directory.

reviews:
  path_instructions:
    - path: "src/api/**"
      instructions: |
        - All endpoints must validate input via zod schemas
        - Auth middleware required before route handlers

2. Pre-merge checks → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/pr-reviews/pre-merge-checks )

Block PRs that violate your standards.

reviews:
  pre_merge_checks:
    docstrings:
      mode: "warning"
      threshold: 80
    description:
      mode: "warning"

Start both in warning mode. Move to error once your team is aligned. When paired with the Request Changes Workflow ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/reference/configuration#param-request-changes-workflow ), error mode blocks merges until issues are resolved or manually overridden.

Learn more about path instructions → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/configuration/path-instructions )
